rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for using one person or thing in place of another.

example.english: We can substitute soy milk for cow's milk.
example.traditional: 我哋可以用豆漿代替牛奶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jung6 dau6 zoeng1 doi6 tai3 ngau4 naai5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a substitute object, material, or product.

example.english: This plastic cup can be a substitute for a glass.
example.traditional: 呢隻膠杯可以做玻璃杯嘅代用品。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gaau1 bui1 ho2 ji5 zou6 bo1 lei1 bui1 ge3 doi6 jung6 ban2

rows.note: Use this for a person standing in for another person, such as a body double or stand-in.

example.english: During filming, the substitute performs the dangerous stunts.
example.traditional: 拍戲嗰陣，危險動作由替身代做。
example.jyutping: paak3 hei3 go2 zan6 ngai4 him2 dung6 zok3 jau4 tai3 san1 doi6 zou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when one player is taken off and another player comes on.

example.english: The coach says we need to substitute a player.
example.jyutping: ling5 deoi6 waa6 jiu3 wun6 jan4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a teacher filling in for the regular teacher.

example.english: There will be a substitute teacher teaching us this Friday.
example.traditional: 今個星期五有代課老師幫我哋上堂。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 ng5 jau5 doi6 fo3 lou5 si1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 soeng5 tong4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a reserve player who may be brought into a match.

example.english: The coach told the substitute player to warm up, ready to come on at any time.
example.traditional: 教練叫後備球員熱身，隨時準備入場。
example.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 giu3 hau6 bei6 kau4 jyun4 jit6 san1 ceoi4 si4 zeon2 bei6 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this for an alternative that takes over a role or function, especially in an abstract or lasting replacement.

example.english: In future, robots may substitute for many jobs.
example.traditional: 將來機械人可能會取代好多工種。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 loi4 gei1 haai6 jan4 ho2 nang4 wui5 ceoi2 doi6 hou2 do1 gung1 zung2
